_comment: ALLINONE-AGENT agent permissions & workspace scope (EXAMPLE). Role keys match agents/roles/<role_key>/ directories in this repo. Deliberately contains NO Paperclip company/agent UUIDs — those are production identifiers specific to one existing installation and must be freshly generated per-install by integration/org_provisioner.py, never copied from a template. See agents/roles/organization-roster.example.json for the roster shape (already sanitized in Phase 43) and PHASE-47 for the real provisioning flow.

workspace_allowlist._note: Populated by setup.ps1 from the paths you provide. Never defaults to a whole drive root (e.g. 'D:\') — setup.ps1 actively refuses that pattern.

wave_strategy._note: Default activation plan from the brief: don't auto-run all 11 agents in parallel on first install. Wave-1 agents are active by default; Wave-2 start in standby and must be explicitly activated.

tool_category_definitions._note: What each category actually permits — map these to your real tool-permission mechanism; this is a planning reference, not an enforced schema until wired into the real permission gate.
tool_category_definitions.planning: Read project state, create/update tasks and plans. No code or shell execution.
tool_category_definitions.architecture_review: Read code and docs for design review. No write access.
tool_category_definitions.task_delegation: Create/assign/update tasks across agents. No direct code or shell execution.
tool_category_definitions.code_read: Read access to authorized workspace paths only.
tool_category_definitions.code_write: Write access to authorized workspace paths only; never outside the workspace allowlist.
tool_category_definitions.test_execution: Run test suites within the authorized workspace.
tool_category_definitions.shell: Run shell commands within the authorized workspace; no system-wide administrative commands.
tool_category_definitions.service_control: Start/stop/restart the four ALLINONE-owned scheduled tasks only (see INSTALLER-REFERENCE.md) — never upstream Hermes Agent tasks.
tool_category_definitions.findings_read: Read-only access to VulnClaw findings.db — never write, never expand scanning scope beyond the existing defensive integration.
tool_category_definitions.defensive_scan_readonly: Trigger existing VulnClaw defensive scans against explicitly authorized workspace paths only.
tool_category_definitions.reporting: Generate reports/summaries from already-authorized data; no new data access beyond what the role already has.
